method: Computed the supplied PDF's SHA-256 hash, byte size and page count and compared the hash with every evidence catalog.
Extracted embedded text from all 26 pages and rendered every page for visual review.
Matched the supplied binary exactly to established PFAS record 082-18e25560cde6, formerly labeled A13 - Complete Test Results.pdf.
Reused the established record rather than creating a duplicate, localized the complete PDF for the site reader and download action, and added a first-page preview.
Added one conservative timeline event covering only the printed address and LDFA analytical tables, then rechecked every open evidence requirement.
qualityFindings: The first page is populated; no blank-page omission is required.

Pages 1-8 preserve EGLE Cadillac Industrial Park address-result rounds collected from October 30, 2024 through February 7, 2025, including field-blank notes and highlighted drinking-water-criteria exceedances.
Pages 22-26 preserve City of Cadillac LDFA Special Investigation results for plant effluent, I-5, S-series and I-series samples.
The address labels are anonymized and the PDF contains no coordinate crosswalk or chain-of-custody package tying each address to a named property.

queueResolution.reason: No request is closed. The compilation adds consolidated analytical context, but it is not EGLE Work Order 2509147, does not provide Plett-specific COCs, does not identify each anonymized address by coordinates and does not supply a synchronized source-to-receptor field/QC package.
